description: This file defines a PHP class for CAPTCHA-related functionalities within the OpenCart platform. It includes methods for generating CAPTCHA images, validating user input, and managing CAPTCHA sessions, specifically for a basic CAPTCHA implementation.

classes.name: Basic
classes.description: A PHP class extending the OpenCart Controller system that provides CAPTCHA functionality including generating CAPTCHA images, validation, and session management.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads language files, sets route data, generates a captcha token, and returns the CAPTCHA view.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the user input against the session captcha value. Returns an error message if invalid, otherwise an empty string.

methods.name: captcha
methods.description: Generates a CAPTCHA image with random ellipses and overlay text, outputs it as a JPEG image, and then destroys the image resource.
